package.description: Trigram-indexed grep with a client/server architecture for fast regex search.

en-US.description: Trigram-indexed grep with a client/server architecture for fast regex search.
en-US.longDescription: tgrep is a trigram-indexed grep with a client/server architecture for fast regex search in large codebases. It pre-builds a trigram index so a search only touches the files that could match, and a background server watches for file changes so subsequent searches stay fast. It is integrated into GitHub Copilot CLI to power fast grep searches across large repositories.
en-US.name: tgrep

zh-CN.description: 基于三元组索引、采用客户端/服务器架构的快速正则搜索工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: tgrep 是一款采用客户端/服务器架构的三元组索引 grep 工具，用于在大型代码库中快速执行正则搜索。它预先构建三元组索引，让搜索只触及可能匹配的文件；后台服务器会监视文件变化，让后续搜索保持极速。它已被集成到 GitHub Copilot CLI，用于在大型仓库中执行快速 grep 搜索。
